ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between intimacy and romance. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between relationships and family. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between routine and conversations. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between romance and money. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between family and your image. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between money and friendships. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your image and your career. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your career and relationships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.
